description: Measurements quoted in the README, transcribed from the dated experiment records under docs/. They were produced on a 4-GPU cluster node during the 2026 internship; the raw QC reports stayed on that cluster and are not part of this repository, so these values cannot be recomputed from the repository alone. tests/test_reported_results.py checks that every value below appears verbatim both in its source record and in the README.

metrics.meaning: Cross-view depth-overlap MAE of the repaired perspective views (pseudo-views), measured before distillation, without and with depth-aware peer synchronisation. Includes the H300 <-> H000 horizontal closure pair. Lower is better.

Final distilled ERP video, first ArtiFixer3D+ run at 451k versus the depth + loop variant: temporal warp MAE and seam MAE. Lower is better; the depth + loop variant is not better on either, so the pseudo-view gain did not clearly survive distillation.

117-frame reference run with a smoothed forward-facing 14-view rig (1,638 renders at 768 x 768), two 77-frame windows, 8 denoising steps. Optical-flow temporal warp MAE and edge flicker, median over the clip, raw 3DGRUT input renders versus pipeline output. Lower is better. The edge-strength ratio (output / high-confidence input, 1 = fully retained) shows that part of the stability comes with softer detail.
COLMAP 4.1.1 pose reconstruction of the 117-frame reference clip (ALIKED + LightGlue, one shared SIMPLE_RADIAL camera).

Optional two-yaw VEnhancer post-process applied to the 117-frame output: temporal warp MAE and edge flicker before -> after. It smooths and can reinterpret weak texture, so it is a perceptual enhancement and not a geometric validation.

Mean seam-failure fraction over the 12 cubemap face adjacencies (an adjacency fails above 0.1), raw 120k cubemap versus the same faces repaired independently by ArtiFixer, and the geometry-locked 3D variant. Lower is better. The locked variant is seam-consistent only because geometry cannot move; its geometric artifacts remain.

Full 154-frame, 14-direction run (2,156 perspective views, 1024 x 512 ERP). Spherical coverage and exact source-pixel reinsertion passed; the final acceptance gates on seam and temporal stability failed.

Share of the full sphere seen by the source pinhole camera at one pose (rectangular solid angle of a 1972 x 1087 image with a 924.0169 px focal length). This figure is recomputed from the intrinsics by the test suite.
Earlier internship baseline, not produced by this pipeline: plain video -> COLMAP -> Nerfstudio Splatfacto on a 70/30 split, PSNR (dB) and SSIM after 30k and 60k iterations.
